mermaid:
timeline
  title How a vaccine trains your body
  Minutes : Shot given
  Hours : Alarm raised
  Days : Helpers trained
  Weeks : Blockers built
  Months : Memory kept
  Later : Rematch won

nodes.explanation: The shot delivers a harmless stand-in carrying the germ's markers.
nodes.label: Vaccine enters arm

nodes.explanation: Guard cells grab the markers and call for help. Soreness means defenses mobilize.
nodes.label: Alarm signals sent

nodes.explanation: Messengers carry markers to glands where helper cells confirm the threat.
nodes.label: Helper cells activated

nodes.explanation: Some cells become factories pouring out blockers shaped for these markers.
nodes.label: Blocker factories start

nodes.explanation: Blockers tag the stand-in for removal over the next week or two.
nodes.label: Germs cleared out

nodes.explanation: Most fighters stand down, but veteran cells remember the markers for years.
nodes.label: Memory cells remain

nodes.explanation: Memory cells skip slow learning and flood the body with blockers within hours.
nodes.label: Faster response ready

nodes.explanation: The real germ is stopped before you feel sick. Boosters refresh this memory.
nodes.label: Real germ defeated

title: Training day for your immune system
